verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs list a first-party `lms chat` command described as starting an interactive chat with a model in the terminal, which is exactly this story. Only a one-line command listing backs it, with no further depth or outside confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on `lms chat` usage (model selection, flags, session behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration of terminal chat.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal

citations.quote: chat               Start an interactive chat with a model
